name: table top bridge rotation
description: A table top bridge with an arm sweep and trunk rotation. It trains the glutes while opening the chest and challenging balance.
instructions: Set up in a table top bridge with hips lifted and hands under your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and both feet.
Lift the free arm and reach it up and over your body as you rotate your chest.
Keep your hips high and level throughout.
Return the arm to the floor and repeat, then switch sides.
